[P2] Add the required public-type consumer example

These exported fields change the contract for consumers with `exactOptionalPropertyTypes`: explicit `undefined` becomes accepted, and property-presence checks no longer guarantee defined values. Root `AGENTS.md` Tests rule 3 requires an example for public API changes, but this diff adds none, and existing examples compile without the flag. The reported generic compiler probe does not validate the SDK declarations. Add an examples-package consumer fixture compiled in CI with the flag enabled that exercises explicit undefined values and safe narrowing of the affected public fields.
